principle: Model/computation identities are host-agnostic; learning, authority and observed behavior each need separately measured evidence.

opportunities.description: Train a small sparse readout to predict exact declared H-step structural transfer for held-out neuron-source/target queries while retaining the full-source oracle.
opportunities.data: Version-pinned OpenWorm c302 directed synapse counts plus source/target/horizon query splits.
opportunities.target: Exact outgoing-synapse-count-normalized transfer, explicitly synthetic model labels.
opportunities.candidate: Constrained learned readout or query-conditioned sparse graph neural net.
opportunities.loss: Absolute rational transfer deviation and cross-entropy on reachable/non-reachable labels, reported separately.
opportunities.split: Hold out source and target neuron pairs, not only repeated samples from one pair.
opportunities.promotion: No claim of learned biological function: labels are generated by our structural transfer law.

opportunities.description: Train a query planner to choose small causal subcircuits or useful graph probes before realization; exact Ground invariants must still certify selected outputs.
opportunities.data: Retained RCG-001 query capsules, planner probe counts and attribution by observation.
opportunities.target: Minimize total measured planning + realization + verification cost without changing task-relative exact answers.
opportunities.candidate: Imitation or contextual bandit over bounded reachability decisions, with hard exact oracle gate.
opportunities.loss: Measured end-to-end cost plus hard incorrect-answer refusal.
opportunities.split: Hold out distinct query families, horizons and edge types.
opportunities.promotion: A learned suggestion never becomes an accepted observation without rechecking the receiver-owned original source Ground.

opportunities.description: Incorporate real stimulus-to-neural-response recordings and transmitter-sign evidence, then fit a dynamics model on top of fixed biological connectivity.
opportunities.data: Source-pinned FlyVis or other independently recorded stimulus-response datasets; cell identity alignment must be established.
opportunities.target: Held-out measured neural responses, not the structural-transfer approximation.
opportunities.candidate: Constrained continuous-time recurrent rate or spiking model with source-labeled observables.
opportunities.loss: Time-aligned response prediction error under withheld stimuli and cells.
baselines: published c302 simulation under its own law
opportunities.split: Withhold sensory stimuli and experimental sessions; preserve provenance.
opportunities.promotion: Require real stimuli, sensor provenance, data licensing, cell mappings, and independent experimental agreement. Synapse counts alone do not authorize physiological claims.

opportunities.description: Learn task-relative equivalence and useful retained summaries across observer contexts; compare VGI sparse partial refinement and IFS sufficient statistics.
opportunities.data: Source-bound observations, VGI observer contexts, proof status, unknown edges and deliberately altered contexts.
opportunities.target: Predict which observations reconstruct from retained Ground and which require renewed measurement.
opportunities.candidate: Bounded retrieval policy with exact equivalence certificate and explicit unresolved status.
opportunities.loss: Wrongly claimed equivalence plus measured query cost and retained evidence bytes.
opportunities.split: Withheld observer contexts, partial Grounds and changed source revisions.
opportunities.promotion: A prediction of equivalence is never a proof; existing VGI proof and receiver-attested observation gates remain authoritative.

opportunities.description: Use E-CPU authenticated observer-hosts to collect bounded sensor observations, select permitted actions and recover tasks after receiver death.
opportunities.data: Timestamped authenticated observations, action receipts, external reference and E-CPU M3 quorum roots.
opportunities.target: Reliable minimal-cost closed-loop execution of explicitly authorized bounded tasks.
opportunities.candidate: Event-sourced task-specific sensorimotor policy over E-CPU Transit, Virtual Layer and M3.
opportunities.loss: Missed observations, incorrect actions, delay, unrecoverable state and task error.
baselines: E-CPU Transit recovery without learned routing
opportunities.split: Withheld hosts, transient losses and crash-cut positions.
opportunities.promotion: No unapproved physical actuation; host permissions, source identity, task constraints and network recovery must be witnessed.

opportunities.description: Train a high-level policy to decide when to navigate a known Ground, call an admitted model, acquire missing evidence, or explicitly abstain.
opportunities.data: Task-specific observations with outcomes/costs, VGI evidence states and source-pinned pretrained model Ground identities.
opportunities.target: Task success and calibrated abstention under bounded computation and communication budgets.
opportunities.candidate: Context-conditioned policy with source-pinned retrieval and evidence-directed acquisition.
opportunities.loss: Measured task failure, unverifiable claim, resource cost and authority violation.
opportunities.split: Withheld tasks, new source contexts, changed host topology and noisy observations.
opportunities.promotion: Neither source graphs nor parameter counts alone constitute intelligence. Independently verify observed task outcomes.
